 impurities such as herbs, shells, papers and plastic bottles before
entering to the main cooling pump.
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be
performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above titled block.

Introduction
The Traveling water screen system is used for cleaning the Raw water from the 
 impurities such as herbs, shells, papers and plastic bottles before
entering to the main cooling pump.
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be
performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above titled block.
The 
 first draft initiated by eng. Dalia Harhash Abd_elfatah, tested by eng. Ahmed 
 Elsaaedy, accepted by eng. Khamis Elsherif : maintenance general director and 
 approved by eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby head sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.
This 
 document reviewed by eng. Abouda El bana Inspection and quality control 
 engineering, accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed 
 Nageeb inspection & quality controls head sector.
